english.title: With intent to deceive, produce document which is false in a material particular – plastic packaging tax
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[produced or provided]_
(B)_[caused to be produced or provided]_
(C)_[made use of]_

a document, namely **(..DESCRIBE DOCUMENT..), which was false in a material particular intending to

(D)_[deceive a person]_
(E)_[secure that a machine responded to it as if it were a true document]_

for a purpose connected with plastic packaging tax
english.legislation: Contrary to section 78(1) and (3) Finance Act 2021.

date and location

Either way -

Summary: maximum six months imprisonment and/or fine not exceeding £20,000 or (if greater) three times the total of amounts of plastic packaging tax that were, or were intended to be, evaded.Indictment: maximum seven years imprisonment and/or fine. Time limit for prosecutionsNone
